mentions.name: Engineering correctness layer (ologs)
mentions.description: This project builds a correctness layer between man and machine using formal methods, specifically category-theory ologs that model the structure (taxonomy and ontology) of a business domain. It includes a manifesto laying out the vision and an olog editor for authoring these domain models.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on engineering correctness. Aka on a correctness layer between man - machine. [0]

This means formal methods, but the new ones like the ologs from category theory. Which can easily model the structure (taxonomy and ontology) of a (business) domain. [1]
mentions.author: csbartus
